label: Move up the tab list
description: Keybind to select the previous (upward) tab. Type it manually, or enable "Record" below and press the keys. Combine modifiers (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Meta/Cmd, or Accel) with a key using +. Examples: Ctrl+Shift+ArrowUp, Alt+K, Accel+PageUp.

label: Record Move Up keybind
description: Enable this, then focus the browser window and press the key combination you want. It is saved to "Move up the tab list" above. Press Esc (or wait 10s) to cancel.

label: Move down the tab list
description: Keybind to select the next (downward) tab. Type it manually, or enable "Record" below and press the keys. Combine modifiers (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Meta/Cmd, or Accel) with a key using +. Examples: Ctrl+Shift+ArrowDown, Alt+J, Accel+PageDown.

label: Record Move Down keybind
description: Enable this, then focus the browser window and press the key combination you want. It is saved to "Move down the tab list" above. Press Esc (or wait 10s) to cancel.

label: Skip unloaded pinned tabs
description: When navigating, skip over pinned tabs that haven't been loaded yet (discarded or never-opened), landing on the next loaded tab instead.

label: Pause media when leaving a tab
description: When you navigate away from a tab with playing audio/video, pause it. When you navigate back, resume it — but only if this mod was the one that paused it (it stays paused if you had paused it yourself).
